plan.purpose: Bounded direct-BIO development pilot after exact unchanged-source qualification. No retention or speedup claim from this pilot alone.
plan.hypothesis: Replacing only detached lower-WRITE dm_io descriptor/mapping work with one preallocated parent BIO reduces software submission cost enough to improve useful I/O without changing lower-success publication or service timing scope.
plan.primary_endpoint: Within-round paired log ratio of (candidate swapz useful WRITE / same-session raw WRITE) / (control swapz useful WRITE / same-session raw WRITE). Average log repeats within source block first; a source round is the sampling unit.
plan.analysis: Report 98.333333 percent paired log-effect Student-t intervals and exact two-sided sign p values with Bonferroni cutoff 0.05/3. With only three round units, pilot cannot qualify significance. Use it solely to decide whether a fixed larger confirmation merits running; never infer equivalence.
secondary_endpoints: independent lower READ/WRITE bytes and requests
host CPU/PSI, replay CPU, resource gauges
exclusions: more than 10 percent paired raw-WRITE spread between matched source blocks
failed byte oracle or missing data (failure requires resolution)
plan.constants: Existing make fast_test device geometry, seeds and matched immutable trace/content; DELTA64=1; no model retuning. Compare persistent only with persistent, matched waves only with matched waves.
retention_prerequisites: actual-body native tests and kernel builds
owned forced-split completion and genuine lower-error coverage
prospectively fixed counterbalanced confirmation with practical effect and adjusted direction evidence
plan.pair_rule: Require both declared repeats to be SCREENED in both source blocks and exact matching fixture/trace/model/replay/policy. Otherwise exclude that whole round for that scenario; no replacement. Compare geometric mean raw WRITE across matched blocks for the 10 percent drift gate.

verdict: REMOVE: unpromising bounded development pilot. No repeatable material primary service benefit was established; this is not proof of equivalence or a statistically qualified regression. Restore qualified production C; do not retain the adapter.

validation.candidate_exact_source_make_test: NOT RUN; experiment removed before retention

secondary_scope: Secondary intervals are descriptive, not a simultaneous confidence family or promotion verdict. Exact direction tests and practical effect criteria are not satisfied by this pilot.
